title: The tour's two documents
description: What an application that carries a tour serves at GET /tour and GET /tour/feedback.
note: What an application that carries a tour serves: GET /tour, its journeys in
their order, each stage with its line, what to try on it and its latest word;
and GET /tour/feedback, every word kept, oldest first. The record is
Shared, not owned: the application emits these and the harness reads them,
and neither imports the other. project-seed/tour-vectors.json is the cases
that keep both honest, and project-seed/ci/tour_document.py checks a document,
or every case, against this file.
Each object may carry keys beyond the ones named here, and a reader passes
them over. Three rules hold that a schema cannot state, and
tour_document.py checks them beside it: a stage's id is its journey's id, a
slash and its own stage; a stage's journey is the id of the journey it is
listed under; no two stages anywhere in the document share an id.

journeys.description: In the order the application declares them, which is the tour's order.

feedback.description: GET /tour/feedback: every word kept, oldest first. A stage's feedback is the latest record that names it.

commit.description: The commit the application runs, or null where it cannot say: then no word is tied to a build, and each counts.

changed.description: Whether the application's tree had changes beside that commit, or null where it cannot say.

id.description: What a roadmap can name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, as `journey:<id>`.

words.description: The stage's own line, the one the application shows where it shows the journey. The tour has no words of its own.

tries.description: What there is to try on the stage, in order.

feedback.description: The latest word on the stage, with whether it was said of the build now running; null with none.

try.description: A step of a walkthrough page that goes through the stage, or a page that shows the same thing whole (index null).

heading.description: The step's heading, or the page's number and title.

page.description: The walkthrough page, by its file name under walkthrough/. A try with none is not a page of the walkthrough, and the review does not count it as one.

index.description: The step's number on its page, or null for the page whole.

picture.description: The picture the run took after the step, as the page links it, or null.

shown.description: What the page showed at the step, or null.

word.description: One person's word on one stage, never rewritten.

note.description: What is off, in the person's words; empty for works.

by.description: The name the word was given under. The application refuses a new word without one; a record kept before words carried a name has none, and a reader prints nothing in its place.

at.description: The moment, ISO 8601 with its offset.

latest.description: A word as GET /tour embeds it: the stage's latest, and whether it is current, said of the commit the application runs.
